text:
Rae (Design): quick prototype posted of the playground preview + run-history compact row: https://figma.com/file/playground-preview (gif)
Rae (Design): problem: users don't notice actions (copy/open/map) on structured tool outputs. preview looks like read-only text.
Jun (DevEx): saw support requests where people didn't realize they could open the table viewer. We need a discoverable primary affordance.
Marta (Frontend): idea: show a persistent right-edge CTA "Open table" for structured outputs, and a hover action strip for secondary actions. keep CTA in DOM after preview for keyboard users.
Ira (A11y): accessibility: CTA must be focusable and announced as "Open table viewer for excel_extract output". action strip should not be hidden purely by :hover; reveal via focus too. aria-controls between CTA and table viewer.
Eli (PM): telemetry ask: events `preview_opened`, `preview_action_clicked` with action type and tool id. include whether preview was expanded first.
Rae (Design): copy tweak: use verbs: "Open table", "Copy JSON", "Map to schema". small tooltip on hover for long tool ids.
Marta (Frontend): implementation notes: disable "Open table" for >200KB payloads with tooltip "Large payload: open in new tab". streaming: show spinner in CTA until first chunk completes.
Ira (A11y): screenreader announcements: only announce CTA enablement state (aria-live polite) when it changes to enabled. avoid announcing streaming chunks.
Jun (DevEx): run-history tie-in: add micro-metadata inline (type + count) so users can scan which rows have structured outputs. show a small badge "table · 3 rows" in the summary.
Rae (Design): mock variations: right-edge CTA vs inline strip. I'll run quick hallway tests and prefer the right-edge CTA for dense logs.
Marta (Frontend): I'll prototype branch `devex/preview-actions-cta`. ETA 3 dev days. will pair with Ira for a11y review.
Ira (A11y): I'll own the accessibility checklist and test keyboard + screen reader flows. ensure toasts are announced once.
ci-bot: preview deployed to staging: https://staging.playground/redwood/preview-2119990000 :white_check_mark:
Eli (PM): quick reaction poll: :thumbsup: for right-edge CTA, :eyes: for inline strip. please react.
Rae (Design): thanks all — will upload final frames and a short 5-step test script for QA.
